metadata.title: Chorus — live polls, Q&A and quizzes for any room
metadata.description: Run live polls, audience Q&A and quizzes in meetings, classes and conferences. Your audience joins with a code — no account, no app.

footer.tagline: Live polls, Q&A and quizzes for meetings, classes and conferences.

hero.title: Your audience has more to say than the loudest person in the room.
hero.body: Chorus turns any meeting, class or conference into a two-way conversation with live polls, upvoted Q&A and quizzes. Your audience joins with a short code, with no account and no download.

noAccount.title: No account for participants
noAccount.body: They open a link and answer. That is the whole flow.

anyPhone.title: Works on any phone
anyPhone.body: A browser is the only requirement, on any network.

liveResults.title: Results as they arrive
liveResults.body: Every answer updates the screen the moment it lands.

product.title: Six ways to hear from a room
product.body: Mix them in a single event and move between them as the session goes.

polls.title: Live polls
polls.body: Multiple choice, ranking and open text. Results build on screen as people answer.

qa.title: Q&A with upvotes
qa.body: The room decides what gets asked. Best questions rise, and you moderate before they appear.

quizzes.title: Quizzes
quizzes.body: Timed questions, points for speed, and a leaderboard that lands at the end.

wordClouds.title: Word clouds
wordClouds.body: Short answers cluster into a cloud that grows with every submission.

ratings.title: Ratings
ratings.body: Ask for a number from 1 to 10 and see the distribution, not just the average.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Participation, response counts and per-question breakdowns after the room empties.

create.title: Create your event
create.body: Add polls, a Q&A or a quiz in a couple of minutes.

share.title: Share the code
share.body: Put the short code on screen. People join from any browser.

open.title: Open an interaction
open.body: Push one question at a time to everyone in the room.

watch.title: Watch it land
watch.body: Answers appear as they arrive, on your screen and the projector.

useCases.title: Built for rooms that go quiet

allHands.title: All-hands and team meetings
allHands.body: Take the temperature of the room before the discussion, not after it.

conferences.title: Conferences and keynotes
conferences.body: Let a thousand people ask questions without a microphone queue.

classes.title: Classes and training
classes.body: Check understanding mid-lesson with a quiz that scores itself.

workshops.title: Workshops and webinars
workshops.body: Keep remote attendees answering instead of quietly leaving.

pricing.title: Free while it is yours
pricing.body: This is a self-hosted Chorus instance. Unlimited events, unlimited participants, every interaction type. The only limit is your database.
